verdictDetail: Independent audit of the frozen implementation commit 6fb22850aa7acdcea3e4959024d93ea5adc54842. The machine gate (54/54), the adversarial suite (41/41), the 19 auditor-authored mutations (19/19 detected), the git ancestry and scope checks, the applicability challenge (9x14 + 6x14), the predecessor mapping (58/39/23/14 = 134, 0 closed/deleted), the economic-operator, GDPR/CRA, consumer-rights and claims-enforcement reviews all verify. One MAJOR defect (A-01) and nine MINOR defects remain open: the research source trail (CSV + dossier) and the governed source register (legal-sources.json + D02) publish contradictory verification statuses and counts (14 vs 4 'verified this session'; 50 vs 48 rows; 12 directly contradictory records), and a stale 2025-02-01 RED delegated-regulation date survives in the governed requirement. Because A-01 is MAJOR, no internal-scope award is issued now (fail-closed). After the correction list below is applied and re-verified, the evidence supports PASS_INTERNAL_LEGAL_GOVERNANCE_SCOPE with programme status PARTIAL: internal legal/commercial governance PASS, external legal clearance NOT_GRANTED (mirroring MC-13). No sale, certification, legal clearance, insurance, licence, publication, merge or deployment is authorised by this record.
correctionsRequiredBeforeAward: A-01 (MAJOR): reconcile verification statuses and counts across research/mc14-legal-sources.csv, research/MC14-LEGAL-RESEARCH-DOSSIER.md and data/legal-sources.json + D02 so each source has one status and one documented count; explain the 48 vs 50 membership difference or make the registers identical.
A-02: correct the stale 2025-02-01 RED delegated-regulation date to 2025-08-01 in REQ-DELREG-01 (D02 line 112 and data/legal-sources.json line 1589).
A-03: correct SRC-EU-SCA-2018-389 effectiveDate (entry into force 2018-03-14; application 2019-09-14) and the dossier table value.
A-04: add the D19-declared fields to bundle assessments or amend D19 section 3.3 to state that bundle assessments omit them by design.
A-05: make D03 reproduce the governed WEATHER/BATTERIES and FLEET/BATTERIES rationales verbatim.
A-06: correct the public-URL attribution in website-findings.json/D15/D18/mc15-handoff-inputs.json to the real route registry (unprefixed Spanish routes; no /es/legal/* or /es/tienda/checkout).
A-07: correct D20 section 3 to the reproducible frozen-commit result (54/54, not 53/54).
A-08: reconcile the class C pre-evidence status (INTERNAL_ONLY per approvalWorkflow step 4 and D13 line 68) with the three PUBLIC_PROHIBITED class C claims.
A-09: qualify or correct the D02 'no compliance conclusion rests on a non-retrieved source' rule for REQ-ES-LGP-01, or retrieve the LGP 34/1988 text and re-status the requirement.
A-10: replace the dossier's 'recital 580' CRA citation with Article 71 and note the correction.

findings.title: Research source trail and governed source register publish contradictory verification statuses and counts (14 vs 4 sessions-verified; 50 vs 48 sources; 12 directly contradictory records)
findings.evidence: Governed register: data/legal-sources.json:1289-1297 (sourceCounts total 48, verifiedThisSession 4, consumed 32, partly verified 2, not-retrieved-or-inaccessible 10), D02 MC14-PRIMARY-LEGAL-SOURCE-REGISTER.md:24 ('48 sources — 4 verified this session, 32 consumed, 2 partially verified, 10 not retrieved/inaccessible'), and e.g. data/legal-sources.json:19-30 marks SRC-EU-CRA-2024-2847 CONSUMED_FROM_PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE. Research trail: research/mc14-legal-sources.csv lines 2,3,5,6,9,20,21,23,35,36,37,44,45,46 record 14 rows as RE_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION; research/MC14-LEGAL-RESEARCH-DOSSIER.md:24-29 reports 50 rows (14 RE_VERIFIED / 25 CONSUMED / 6 NOT_RETRIEVED / 5 INACCESSIBLE), dossier :41 records the CRA as RE_VERIFIED and section 4.1 (:697) refers to the 'fetched OJ excerpt'. The dossier's own definition (:25) is 'RE_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION (official page fetched 2026-11-02)', which is mutually exclusive with the governed 'CONSUMED_FROM_PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE ... not re-fetched' (:26). 12 sources are contradictory across the layers (CRA, GPSR, DCD, UCPD, eCommerce, RD 186/2016, RD 187/2016, NMEA 2000 licensing, NMEA 0183, NMEA certification, TRLGDCU, LSSI); 4 research-only rows (SRC-ES-AUTORIDAD-CONSUMIDOR, SRC-WIPO-GLOBAL-BRAND-DB, SRC-IEC-60945, SRC-ISO-16315) are absent from the governed register and 2 governed sources (SRC-EU-DB-96-9, SRC-ES-AEMET-TERMS) are absent from the CSV; the CSV vocabulary RE_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION is not in data/legal-sources.json:verificationVocabulary. No document reconciles the 48/50 or 4/14 difference. No legal conclusion changes (all conclusions are NOT_ASSESSED/NON_COMPLIANT/UNDETERMINED), but the provenance trail on which the milestone's evidence standard rests is internally contradictory.
findings.correction: Reconcile the three artifacts in one pass: decide the true status of each source (re-fetched this session vs consumed from named predecessor evidence), make the CSV, dossier, legal-sources.json and D02 agree, document the 48-vs-50 membership rule (governed register excludes non-law standards/authority information pages) or make membership identical, and use one verification vocabulary. Recompute the published counts.
findings.reVerification: Re-run the auditor comparison: one status per source across CSV, dossier, legal-sources.json and D02; counts 48/50 reconciliation documented; no source claimed both RE_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION and CONSUMED_FROM_PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE.

findings.title: SCA RTS 2018/389 entry-into-force date is wrong in the governed register (and differently wrong in the dossier)
findings.evidence: data/legal-sources.json:646-656 gives SRC-EU-SCA-2018-389 publicationDate 2018-03-13, effectiveDate 2018-09-14, applicationDate 2019-09-14. honestLimit: This review verifies internal consistency, evidence handling, applicability reasoning, inherited-blocker mapping and claims enforcement against the frozen commit. It is not a legal opinion, not a conformity assessment, not an insurance or licence review and not an authorisation to sell or publish. External legal clearance remains NOT_GRANTED and every external decision remains PENDING or OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOR_MC14. The two 2026 instruments (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/339 and the PLD corrigendum OJ L 2026/90364) and the RD 188/2016 art 9.8 Spanish-language duty were independently re-retrieved from EUR-Lex/BOE-adjacent sources during this audit; the full corpus was not re-fetched source by source, so the audit verifies the register's internal provenance claims and their contradictions rather than replacing the research. No sale, certification, legal clearance, publication, merge or deployment is authorised by this record.
